NewsDesk developer reference¶

See the project README for database, SMTP, account roles and usage instructions. This reference extracts docstrings from the application source.

Views¶

Handle news browsing, role-restricted publishing and reader preferences.

news.views.add_comment(request, pk)[source]¶

Save a validated reader comment on an approved article using POST.

news.views.approve_article(request, pk)[source]¶

Publish an editor-approved draft and deliver queued reader notifications.

Approval and notification records commit before SMTP is attempted. A repeated POST retries only unsent notifications and does not duplicate tracked mail.

news.views.article_create(request)[source]¶

Allow journalists to submit drafts for editorial approval.

news.views.article_delete(request, pk)[source]¶

Let editors or the owning journalist confirm and delete an article.

news.views.article_detail(request, pk)[source]¶

Show a visible article, returning 404 for drafts the user cannot access.

news.views.article_update(request, pk)[source]¶

Edit authorized content and require approval again after any change.

news.views.dashboard(request)[source]¶

List an editor’s review queue or a journalist’s own submissions.

news.views.external_news(request)[source]¶

Render external stories while allowing the service to handle outages.

news.views.home(request)[source]¶

Render approved news with optional title, body and category filters.

news.views.newsletter_create(request)[source]¶

Let journalists and editors curate a collection of approved articles.

news.views.newsletter_delete(request, pk)[source]¶

Confirm and delete a newsletter only for its owner or an editor.

news.views.newsletter_detail(request, pk)[source]¶

Show a newsletter while excluding linked articles returned to draft.

news.views.newsletter_update(request, pk)[source]¶

Allow an owning journalist or editor to revise newsletter content.

news.views.newsletters(request)[source]¶

List newsletters for registered news roles.

news.views.register(request)[source]¶

Create an account with its selected role and sign the new user in.

news.views.saved_articles(request)[source]¶

Display the reader’s bookmarks, excluding articles returned to draft.

news.views.subscriptions(request)[source]¶

Return published stories plus drafts the current account may manage.

Services¶

Fetch external headlines and deliver approved news to subscribed readers.

news.services.fetch_external_news(query='technology', limit=10)[source]¶

Fetch normalized stories, returning an empty list on HTTP/JSON errors.

Parameters:

  • query (str) – Search terms, defaulting to technology.

  • limit (int) – Maximum number of requested results, defaulting to 10.

Returns:

Dictionaries containing title, url, author, and created_at.

Return type:

list[dict]

The request has a five-second timeout. Entries without a title are skipped.

news.services.post_approved_article(article)[source]¶

POST an approved article ID to the configured local API and report success.

No network request occurs without an operator-provided key. The receiver is idempotent; failed delivery can be retried through either approval view.

news.services.queue_publication_emails(article)[source]¶

Snapshot subscribed reader addresses once for an approved article.

Call inside the approval transaction. Following both the publisher and the journalist still produces only one notification for each reader.

news.services.send_publication_emails(article)[source]¶

Deliver unsent notifications privately and return the failure count.

Lock each notification while sending to serialize simultaneous retry requests. SMTP errors leave it unsent for an editor’s later retry. A process crash after SMTP accepts a message but before the database commit can still duplicate mail.

Custom user¶

Provide the custom user model for NewsDesk authentication.

The model reuses legacy account tables. Role and subscription state is stored on the related news profile, preserving existing accounts during consolidation.

class accounts.models.User(*args, **kwargs)[source]¶

Expose role-specific news relationships through a normalized profile.

Use get_user_model() to retrieve this class in application code. The model does not grant editorial access merely because an account is staff.

Reuse the original auth_user table so existing article ownership and password hashes remain valid. Reader subscription joins live on the one-to-one profile; empty/nonapplicable relationships are exposed as None for other roles.

exception DoesNotExist¶
exception MultipleObjectsReturned¶
property independent_articles¶

Return independent articles for journalists, or None for other roles.

property independent_newsletters¶

Return independent newsletters for journalists, or None otherwise.

property journalist_subscriptions¶

Return the reader’s journalist relationship, or None for other roles.

property publisher_subscriptions¶

Return the reader’s publisher relationship, or None for other roles.

property role¶

Read the profile role without creating or modifying a profile.

Returns:

The assigned role, or None for an account without a profile.

Return type:

str or None
